A technique rendering AMR data using 3DTM, partitioning the volume into axis-aligned bricks of the same level of resolution.
It extends the AMR tree-based 3DTM to render large and sparse data sets.
A challenge in cell-centered AMR where stitching across boundaries requires unstructured mesh geometry because dual grids do not align across levels.
This approach (subdividing into tets/hexes) is contrasted with the paper's basis function method which avoids subdivision.
The simplest reconstruction strategy for AMR data, returning the scalar value of the leaf cell containing the query point.
It is fast and simple but not continuous, even within same-level regions.
